description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the EducationService component in the OrangeHRM system. It tests functionalities such as fetching, deleting, and retrieving education entities, utilizing mock objects and test data fixtures.

classes.name: EducationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the EducationService, testing methods like getEducationList, deleteEducations, getEducationById, and getEducationByName.

methods.name: testGetEducationList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteEducations
methods.description: Tests the deletion of Education entities by IDs.

methods.name: testGetEducationById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single Education entity by its ID.

methods.name: testGetEducationByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a single Education entity by its name.

methods.name: setUp
